summary: Singleton of set-transform requests posted by ls::LevelInstanceMoveSystem (moving a level instance moves its entities) and drained by ls::TransformSystem::Update (bg3.exe+0x3C77860), whose WorldView names it together with GameplaySetTransformRequests, InventoryMemberSetTransformRequest, InventoryMemberSetTranslateRequest and ScrollingObjectSetTranslateRequests. Same shape as InventoryMemberSetTransformRequestComponent (SE Components.h: HashMap<EntityHandle, Transform> SetTransform). Registry total 64 on both client and server rows. Never seen alive.
